title: Rare Steak Nutrient Myth

scenes.text: Does a rare steak keep more iron than a well‑done one?
People often think cooking steak to well done destroys most of its iron and protein.
scenes.label: Cooking kills steak iron
scenes.query: well done steak iron loss myth

scenes.text: Studies show only a small reduction in iron (about 5‑10%) with higher doneness, while protein remains largely intact.
scenes.label: Iron loss is minimal

scenes.text: Choose doneness you enjoy; pair with vitamin‑C foods to boost iron absorption.
scenes.label: Enjoy your steak
scenes.sub: Add citrus or bell peppers for better iron uptake.
